## Research Groups

I am a member of the [Cardiff NLP](https://cardiffnlp.github.io/) group and the [Knowledge Representation and Reasoning (KRR)](https://krr.cs.cf.ac.uk/) group at Cardiff University.

## Research Interests

- Scientific machine learning (SciML)
- Multimodal machine learning
- Geometric deep learning and graph neural networks
- Generalisation and distribution shift in machine learning  
- Interpretability and explainability in ML models  
- Neural Rendering & Simulation

## Industry Experience

Before starting my PhD, I worked as a **software engineer** and **machine learning engineer**, leading AI teams across different companies. My applied work has covered:

- Computer vision  
- Speech processing and lip-based biometrics  
- Natural language processing  
- ML infrastructure and open-source software
